title: Mercury-Redstone 1 Launch failure (MR-1)
summary: Footage of the failed Mercury-Redstone 1 launch, where the engine cut off almost immediately after liftoff. The escape tower and parachutes then deployed because the rocket thought the flight was over.
why: Cited as the canonical footage of the famous four-inch flight, usually when discussing aborted launches.

quote.text: If you're only interesting in footage of the failed launch
